issues.issue: [fixed] Transfer counted as spending. The statement's General Fund column (p5) combines General + Employee Benefit + Depreciation + Contingency: its receipts 304,845,668 = 302,753,468 + 1,276,165 + 686,634 + 129,401 exactly (transfers excluded), and its disbursements 286,681,772 = 285,062,114 + 36,889,501 + 4,290,441 + 12,940 - 39,573,163 (+/-61). The General Fund budgetary balance also rolls with no transfers line (56,859,061 + 302,753,468 - 285,062,114 = 74,550,415). So the 39,573,163 sits inside the General Fund program lines (detail[42]-[64]), and those lines also feed the receiving funds' spending in detail. The notes claim it is 'not hidden in a spending line', but their own arithmetic shows it is. The page doesn't say which program lines hold it, so under the hidden-transfer rule add one contra expenditure line (-39,573,163, fund General, split_from naming p8 lines and the p5 elimination, review) plus an other financing line -39,573,163. The detail_totals entry stays 285,062,114 as printed.
